name: The End Times
overview: Scripture reveals that the End Times will be marked by unprecedented tribulation, yet God's faithful people will be delivered, as seen in Daniel 12:1. Jesus emphasizes the necessity of doing the Father's will and enduring until the end to be saved (Matthew 7:21; 24:13). Although the exact timing of these events is unknown to all but the Father (Matthew 24:36), believers are called to remain vigilant and ready, for the Son of Man will come unexpectedly (Matthew 24:44). The days of tribulation will be shortened for the sake of the elect, underscoring God's sovereign protection over His people (Matthew 24:22).
